issue.title: Remove the promotional CTA from the Storage composition
issue.description:
Simplify the Storage gallery composition by removing the promotional Team plan / Upgrade CTA block from the bottom of the card.

Owner direction:

* Keep the Storage composition focused on storage usage and category breakdown.
* Remove the entire promotional CTA section at the bottom.

Keep:

* "Storage" title
* plan/renewal subtitle
* primary usage value (for example 18.4 of 25 GB used)
* storage progress bar
* Design files / Video / Documents / Other breakdown
* current token-driven styling
* current responsive behavior
* current light/dark behavior

Remove:

* promotional icon tile
* "Team plan" label
* "100 GB and shared libraries." supporting copy
* "Upgrade" button
* the CTA container/surface/shadow that groups those elements

Intent:
The Storage card should read as a clean usage/status composition rather than a storage upsell surface.

Do not:

* redesign the storage chart/progress visualization;
* change the data model or category values;
* change gallery placement/order;
* alter shared Button/Card/Icon primitives;
* replace the CTA with a different promotion;
* add new functionality.

Acceptance:

* The Team plan / Upgrade CTA block no longer appears in the Storage composition.
* The card ends naturally after the storage category breakdown.
* Remaining content spacing is rebalanced so the card does not retain dead space where the CTA was removed.
* Storage title, subtitle, usage value, progress visualization, and category breakdown remain intact.
* Light/dark/theme-token responsiveness remains correct.
* No accessibility, containment, or responsive regression.
